senses: A king of the Kingdom of Israel, living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ki.22.40;
ruler of Israel, son of Ahab
ruler of Judah, son of Jehoram (Joram)

strongs.def: Achazjah, the name of a Jewish and an Israelite king
strongs.from: or (prolonged) אֲחַזְיָהוּ ; from H270 (אָחַז) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has seized
